name: Tech-Top Engineering Co. Ltd.
summary: Tech-Top Engineering Co. Ltd. operates as an engineering firm across both Taiwan and mainland China. The company delivers specialized services for critical infrastructure, encompassing the design and implementation of cleanrooms, air conditioning systems, and laboratory facilities. Their capabilities further extend to providing essential utility solutions such as water and electrical supply networks, alongside advanced fire control systems. Beyond specific facility setups, Tech-Top offers end-to-end project management, from initial engineering design and procurement to construction and complete turnkey project delivery. They also provide comprehensive client support through training programs, system commissioning, and ongoing maintenance services. Diversifying its business activities, the firm is additionally involved in the renewable energy sector, operating solar power plants for electricity generation. Tech-Top Engineering Co. Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
